newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai Danu, Finance One postpone meeting.
newsitem.headline: Thai Danu, Finance One postpone meeting.

text.p: Senior executives of Thai Danu Bank and ailing Finance One Plc on Thursday postponed their board meeting on a proposed merger or takeover of Finance One, until May 23.

Public relations executives from the two companies told Reuters the meeting, originally scheduled for Thursday, had been postponed to May 23 as the companies needed more time to study all the documents.
Officials said the postponement was also due to insufficient information.

Thai investors are eagerly awaiting details of progress of the proposed coming together of the two firms as consolidation in the finance sector is a key element in the government's policy to bolster stability in the financial sector, analysts said.
The proposed deal, announced at the end of February, is said to have run into trouble in recent weeks surrounding valuations of the assets of Finance One -- Thailand's largest finance company.
The central bank said earlier this week that Thai Danu would acquire, rather then merge with, Finance One.
The merger would have been the largest ever between two Thai financial institutions.
